articles.title: After a Nationwide Flight Standstill, a $50 Billion Question
articles.summary: After the longest nationwide ground stop since 9/11, the administration wants $50 billion to modernize air traffic control, while Democrats ask about money already approved.

articles.title: A Key Bridge to Crimea Is Badly Damaged
articles.summary: Ukraine says a weeks-long operation severely damaged the Crimean Bridge, a key road and rail link, days before Putin meets the leaders of China and the US.

articles.title: The Campaign to Bring Jensen Back
articles.summary: More than 175,000 people have signed a petition asking Nvidia to reinstate co-founder Jensen Huang, with backing from Trump and Musk, but the board is not considering it.
